The full lists live on the [Research](research.qmd), [Software & Data](software.qmd), and [Teaching & Talks](teaching.qmd) pages, or in the PDF above. ## Work Experience ### [Open Science Specialist](https://ghe.ethz.ch) Zurich, CH ETH Zurich - Global Health Engineering 2021 - Current - Support faculty, PhD and MSc students in applying reproducible workflows in their research. - Oversee reproducibility and open science aspects of published journal papers; manage online and social media channels. - Set up organisational work, task and project management tools. ### [Director & Founder](https://www.lse.de) Zurich, CH Lars Schöbitz GmbH 2018 - Current - Teaching Data Science with R. - Consultant for city-wide faecal sludge management systems. - Supporting organisations in establishing strong monitoring and evaluation frameworks. ### [Data Science Instructor](https://rstatszh.github.io/website/) Zurich, CH Statistical Office of the Canton of Zurich 2021 - Teaching a Data Science with R course to civil servants. ### Data Science Instructor Boulder, USA University of Colorado Boulder 2021 - Developed and taught an online module to teach R. ### Data and Impact Expert Essex, UK Aquaconsult Limited 2018 - 2021 - Venture Advisor for the Transition to Scale Program in Urban Sanitation by Grand Challenges Canada. - Support to Clean Team (Ghana), Eau&Vie (Bangladesh) and Safi Sana (Ghana). ### Data Science Intern Zurich, CH Statistical Office of the Canton of Zurich 2020 - Developed an R Shiny dashboard for analytics of incoming data analysis requests and an R package for web analytics with Matomo. - Published a fully reproducible news article; supported COVID-19 monitoring and data analysis; organised a session at DINAcon 2020. ## Education ### RStudio Instructor Programme RStudio (Posit) 2019 - 2020 - Certified as an RStudio (Posit) Instructor. ### Environmental and Hygiene Engineering (Dipl.-Ing.) Giessen, DE Mittelhessen University of Applied Sciences (THM) 2008 - 2012 - Thesis: Performance Evaluation of a full-scale DEWATS plant in South Africa. ### ERASMUS Exchange Umea, SE Umea University 2010 - Main subject: Northern Aquatic Systems, including sampling of surface water and analysis of DOC, COD, main nutrients and heavy metals. ### Change and Project Management Mikkeli, FI Mikkeli University of Applied Sciences 2009 ## Selected Publications

## Selected Grants & Awards ### [openwashdata - establishing Data Stewards and increasing FAIRness](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev/prop-eth-ord-explore-02-openwashdata) ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, 2nd call) 2024 - Current - Wrote the proposal and manage the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). Places funded data stewards in partner organisations (UKZN, South Africa; BASEflow, Malawi) and delivers a 12-module data stewardship training programme. ### [washcollab - Enhancing Global WASH Data Accessibility through Collaborative Initiatives](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev/prop-eth-ord-contribute-washweb) ETH Board ORD Program (Contribute) 2024 - Current - Wrote the proposal and manage the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). A partnership between WASHWeb and openwashdata maintaining open-source tools for authoritative WASH data (WHO/UNICEF JMP, World Bank, UN-Water GLAAS, OECD). ### [FAIRqual - FAIR Data Practices for Qualitative Research in Transdisciplinarity](https://github.com/fairqual) ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, Measure 1) 2024 - 2025 - Co-wrote the proposal and contributed to the project (team across TdLab and Global Health Engineering, ETH Zurich). Develops tools and standards for sharing hard-to-anonymise qualitative research data following FAIR principles. ### [National Prize for Open Research Data 2024](https://mavt.ethz.ch/news-and-events/d-mavt-news/2024/12/national-prize-for-open-research-data.html) Swiss Academies of Arts and Sciences 2024 - Awarded to openwashdata, the global open-data community for the WASH sector (project led by Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, Global Health Engineering, ETH Zurich). - Recognition for advancing FAIR and Open Research Data practices in the water, sanitation and hygiene sector. - Watch the prize video: [youtu.be/590qPtQNCD0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=590qPtQNCD0) ## Professional Roles ### [Local Node Leader, Swiss Reproducibility Network (SwissRN)](https://www.swissrn.org/contents/community/nodes/) ETH Zurich - Global Health Engineering 2025 - Current - Local Node Leader for ETH Zurich in SwissRN, promoting reproducible and open research practices across the institution. ### [Member, Data Stewardship Network (DSN)](https://github.com/Global-Health-Engineering/dsn) ETH Zurich 2023 - Current - Data steward for the Global Health Engineering group in ETH Zurich's Data Stewardship Network, an ETH Library / swissuniversities ORD initiative embedding Open Research Data practices across research groups. ### [Member, Expert Sounding Group - ORD Career Paths (Measure 5)](https://ethrat.ch/en/eth-domain/open-research-data/) ETH Board ORD Program 2025 - 2026 - Expert sounding group member for the Measure 5 project Career Paths for Open Research Data Professionals, advising the project through planning, progress monitoring and validation of the final report. ## Technical Skills
